item.title: YEONJUN of TOMORROW X TOGETHER to Show a ‘More Personal Side’ of Himself on 2nd Solo Album
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our music update. We've got some exciting news for K-pop fans. YEONJUN, a member of TOMORROW X TOGETHER, is set to release his second solo album, NO LABELS: PART 02, on July 10th."
[Short music transition]
Host: "This new album follows up his debut solo LP, NO LABELS: PART 01, which dropped last November and featured songs like 'Let Me Tell You' with Daniela of KATSEYE. To give us a sneak peek, YEONJUN just released a cinematic video titled 'CHOI YEONJUN', showcasing his everyday life in a hotel room."
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: "The video gives us a glimpse into YEONJUN's personal side, with simple yet eye-catching shots of him doing ordinary things like brushing his teeth and eating breakfast. It sets the tone for the upcoming album, and we can't wait to hear more."
[Short music transition]
Host: "More details about NO LABELS: PART 02, including the concept and tracklist, will be released in the coming weeks. YEONJUN's previous work has already made waves, with his debut single 'GGUM' and collaborations with KATSEYE. We're excited to see what's next for this talented soloist."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for now. Check out the 'CHOI YEONJUN' video and get ready for NO LABELS: PART 02, dropping on July 10th."
